response.title: which lithium golf cart battery is the lightest
response.answer:
The lightest lithium golf cart batteries are typically LiFePO4 (lithium iron phosphate) batteries designed for 36V or 48V golf carts.

However, the lightest battery depends on how much capacity (Ah) you need. A 48V 50Ah battery can be significantly lighter than a 48V 100Ah battery, but it will generally provide less driving range.

For a fair comparison, it's best to compare batteries with the same voltage and capacity.

The lightest 48V option I found is the Epoch 30Ah at 33 lb, but its small capacity may not be enough for a typical golf cart's range and power requirements.

For a more practical lightweight choice, the Bulldog Lithium Rhino 50Ah at 43 lb is worth considering, provided its 120A continuous discharge rating meets your cart's needs.
